request.style: English, bright female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, hand percussion, celesta, warm, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Timna bore a son to Eliphaz
In the land of Edom he became chief
Descended from Esau and Adah
Amalek rose in the desert wild
A tribal leader of the old line
Rooted in the history of the soil

[Chorus]
Blot out the memory from under heaven
The LORD declared a war for ages
Remember what was done along the way
Their name shall fade in God’s judgment

[Verse]
At Rephidim they attacked from behind
Striking the weary and the worn out
Moses stood on the hill with the staff
Joshua fought with the edge of the sword
Aaron and Hur held his hands up
Until the sunset brought the victory

[Chorus]
Blot out the memory from under heaven
The LORD declared a war for ages
Remember what was done along the way
Their name shall fade in God’s judgment

[Verse]
Samuel spoke to Saul the king
Strike them down and spare nothing at all
Man and woman and child and beast
But Saul kept Agag and the best
He turned away from the command
And the LORD regretted making him king

[Chorus]
Blot out the memory from under heaven
The LORD declared a war for ages
Remember what was done along the way
Their name shall fade in God’s judgment

[Outro]
Do not forget this ancient warning
The hand upon the throne of God
Amalek’s line is judged in history
The banner stands for the faithful
